scenes.headline: How a design system answers a coding agent
scenes.sub: Astryx: React components, a CLI, and an MCP server
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Swizzle! Astryx is Meta's open design system, and it is built to be read by coding agents.

scenes.text: The agent does not get the catalog up front. It asks for one component at a time, so the search that picks it decides everything.
scenes.say: An agent does not get the whole catalog. It asks for one component at a time, so the search that picks it decides what gets built.

scenes.title: Three ways an agent learns Astryx

steps.say: Running init writes a short block into the agent's instructions: how to call the tool, and which styles to import.
The command line answers from the version your project installed, as typed JSON.
The hosted server needs no install. It has two tools, search and get, and it answers from the docs site.

scenes.title: How search ranks a query
scenes.say: Here is how the hosted search ranks a query.

items.say: Score the name and the description, from a hundred for an exact match down to thirty.
Any keyword hit is worth ninety, whether one keyword matched or three.
And a keyword matches inside a word. As matches toast.
Ties keep their order, which is alphabetical.

left.title: What the server returns
left.say: Ask for a toast notification, and Badge, Banner and Item come first. Toast is fifth.

right.title: Count whole-word hits
items: Banner and Toast match both words
right.say: Count whole word hits instead, and Toast moves up to second.

scenes.title: Right component first, out of 24 queries
scenes.say: Over twenty-four plain language queries, the right component came first eleven times. Reordering the same lists by whole word hits makes it sixteen.

scenes.text: Retrieval is cheap when an agent needs a few components. It is only as good as the search that picks them.
scenes.mark: only as good as the search
scenes.say: Fetching docs on demand is cheap. It is only as good as the search that picks them.

recap: Init, CLI and MCP teach the agent
Give the server names, not experiences
scenes.say: Three channels teach the agent. Keyword hits tie. And give the server names, not experiences.
